sources.source: Planning Data special area of conservation dataset
sources.authority: DEFRA / Natural England / JNCC via Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 260 special areas of conservation from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-18 and new data was last found on 2024-09-18.
sources.quality_effect: SAC intersection is a strong protected-habitat constraint, but the mixed-origin warning and older source-discovery date require authoritative readback before parcel scoring.

sources.source: Planning Data special protection area dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 88 special protection areas from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-16 and new data was last found on 2025-02-28.
sources.quality_effect: SPA intersection can support bird-habitat constraint screening, but the platform's mixed-origin statement prevents sole-source high-confidence parcel penalties.

sources.source: Planning Data area of outstanding natural beauty dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 34 areas of outstanding natural beauty from two providers; the collector last ran on 2026-07-20, new data was last found on 2026-02-15, and the origin is stated as fully authoritative.
sources.quality_effect: The designation can be used as an authoritative landscape constraint when an exact geometry relation is executed; designation alone is not a parcel growth score.

sources.authority: Natural England / UNESCO designation via Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 73 Ramsar sites from two providers; the collector last ran on 2026-07-21 and new data was last found on 2024-10-04.
sources.quality_effect: International wetland designation is a strong constraint, but mixed-origin geometry and the older new-data date require authoritative confirmation before scoring.

sources.source: Planning Data world heritage site dataset
sources.authority: UNESCO / Historic England via Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 40 World Heritage Sites from two providers; the collector last ran on 2026-07-21 and new data was last found on 2026-07-11.
sources.quality_effect: The dataset supports designated-heritage screening, but UNESCO remains the definitive list and mixed-origin geometry requires current authoritative readback.

sources.source: Planning Data world heritage site buffer zone dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists nine World Heritage Site buffer zones from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-20 and new data was last found on 2026-06-30.
sources.quality_effect: A buffer-zone relation can flag planning implications, but mixed-origin data and the absence of a buffer for many sites prevent extrapolating coverage.

sources.source: Planning Data protected wreck site dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 58 protected wreck sites from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-20, new data was last found on 2026-07-17, and the origin is stated as fully authoritative.
sources.quality_effect: The designation is authoritative for protected-wreck screening, but it is generally a marine heritage constraint and not a positive development candidate signal.

sources.source: Planning Data heritage at risk dataset
sources.verified_fact: The annually updated register lists 5,490 heritage-at-risk records; the collector last ran on 2026-01-26 and new data was last found on 2025-09-30.
sources.quality_effect: Risk status can support heritage-condition context, but annual cadence, mixed-origin data and asset-type differences block direct parcel scoring without asset relation evidence.
